business_summary: Capital Securities Corporation Limited operates in the financial securities industry in China. It operates through Wealth Management Business, Asset Management Business, Investment Business, Investment Banking Business, and Others segments. The company offers wealth management services, including mutual and private equity funds, margin and credit trading, trust, and credit services, as well as brokerage services, including trading, research, and product sales support services. It also provides fixed income services, such as short-term financing, exchange-traded privately placed corporate bonds, treasury bonds, central bank bills, medium-term notes, financial and convertible bonds, and derivatives. In addition, the company offers investment banking services; equity financing services comprising initial public offerings and refinancing; mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and financial advisory services consisting of major asset purchases or sales, share issuance for asset acquisition, cross-border M&A, mergers and spin-offs, backdoor listings, equity incentives, and market capitalization management; capital intermediary services, including M&A and equity investment funds, M&A and bridge financing, structured and mezzanine financing, and bond resale; and debt financing services, such as corporate bonds, financial bonds, company bonds, and asset securitization services. Further, it provides stock sponsorship and underwriting; bond issuance and underwriting; securities brokerage; commodity futures and financial futures brokerage; asset management; equity investment management; financial consulting; project investment; and consulting services for non-securities businesses. The company serves corporate, institutional, retail, and high-net-worth clients. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. Capital Securities Corporation Limited operates as a subsidiary of Beijing Capital Venture Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Capital Securities Corporation Limited는 중국 금융 증권 업계에서 사업을 운영하고 있습니다. 자산 관리 사업, 자산 관리 사업, 투자 사업, 투자 은행 사업 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 뮤추얼 및 사모펀드, 마진 및 신용 거래, 신탁 및 신용 서비스를 포함한 자산 관리 서비스와 거래, 조사 및 제품 판매 지원 서비스를 포함한 중개 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 단기 금융, 상장지수 사모 회사채, 국고채, 중앙은행 어음, 중기채, 금융채 및 전환사채, 파생상품 등 채권 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 투자 은행 서비스를 제공합니다. 기업공개(IPO) 및 재융자로 구성된 주식 금융 서비스; 주요 자산 매입 또는 매각, 자산 취득을 위한 주식 발행, 국경 간 M&A, 합병 및 분할, 백도어 상장, 지분 인센티브 및 시가총액 관리로 구성된 인수합병(M&A) 및 금융 자문 서비스; M&A 및 주식 투자 펀드, M&A 및 브릿지를 포함한 자본 중개 서비스
